present.label: Read the input
present.story: The first bag holds {n} tiles and the second holds {m}.

length-mismatch.label: Different sizes
length-mismatch.story: The bags hold {n} and {m} tiles. Bags of different sizes can never hold the same letters.

initialize.label: Start the tally
initialize.story: Start a tally sheet with every letter at zero.

tally.label: Tally a pair
tally.story: Pair {i}: add one {add} for the first bag and take one {sub} away for the second. Now {add} is {addCount} and {sub} is {subCount}.

nonzero.label: Not zero
nonzero.story: The tally for {letter} ends at {count}, not zero: one bag has more {letter} tiles.

all-zero.label: Everything cancels
all-zero.story: All {letters} letters cancel out to zero. The bags hold exactly the same tiles.
